mapper.select: SELECT m.version_label, m.execution_type, m.created_at, COUNT(a.analysis_id) AS diagnoses FROM model_versions m LEFT JOIN analysis_runs a ON a.model_version_id = m.model_version_id AND a.status_code = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY m.model_version_id, m.version_label, m.execution_type, m.created_at ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
